text:
In enjoyment there is disease; in family there is fear of loss; in wealth there is fear of the king;  
In honor there is fear of poverty; in strength there is fear of enemies; in beauty there is fear of decay.  
In scripture there is fear of argument; in qualities there is fear of wickedness; in the body there is fear of its end.  
Thus every object in the world is pervaded by fear, and the only thing that is truly free from fear is renunciation.
